name: Snufflenose Owner's Manual
summary: The Snufflenose Owner's Manual is an instructional booklet from Marwig Rustbolt of Snuff Inc., kept beside the goblin entrepreneur Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet. It outlines how to deploy and direct a trained Snufflenose Gopher to locate rare Blueleaf Tubers buried in Razorfen Kraul.

sections.title: A Goblin's Operating Guide
sections.body: Written by Marwig Rustbolt, owner of Snuff Inc., this short guide details how to work with the company's trained snufflenose gophers. These beasts possess a keen sense of smell capable of detecting subterranean Blueleaf Tubers from fifty paces away. The manual instructs prospectors to release a gopher using a ventilated crate and guide its rooting instincts with a command stick, directing the creature through the hostile thorns and quillboar tunnels of Razorfen Kraul to secure the prized culinary delicacies.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Snufflenose Owner's Manual?
faq.answer: It serves as instructions for handling Mebok Mizzyrix's trained snufflenose gophers. Adventurers read it to understand how to deploy the animal from its crate and direct it with a command stick to locate buried Blueleaf Tubers within Razorfen Kraul.

faq.q: Where can I find the manual?
faq.answer: The manual is kept in Ratchet in the Barrens, right near Mebok Mizzyrix alongside the specialized crates and command sticks needed for gathering tubers.

faq.q: Why are snufflenose gophers needed to find Blueleaf Tubers?
aliases: can i find tubers without gophers
faq.answer: Blueleaf tubers grow concealed deep within the earth inside Razorfen Kraul and are virtually impossible for humanoids to spot. The trained gophers possess sharp noses that can detect the scent of a buried tuber from fifty paces away.
It is signed by Marwig Rustbolt, owner of Snuff Inc., who wrote it to teach new owners how to feed, walk and command their gophers with the patented command stick.

angles.text: The manual outlines the retrieval process for Blueleaf Tubers, an underground root considered a rare delicacy by gourmands and traders across Azeroth.
